summary: A member asks {board} to find out whether cheaper money is reaching borrowers before using the rest of its room to cut.
realLife: Some March 15 participants preferred a smaller cut while they waited for evidence that credit channels worked and for other public measures to take effect.
gates: The record identifies the remaining rate room and evidence on credit availability.
